scope: Keep the R2010 TABLE semantic projection incomplete when ODA-documented unknown preamble fields differ from their stated defaults.

authority.interpretation: The fields are explicitly unknown. A non-default value is retained as an unqualified profile and must not be projected as complete TABLE semantics.

implementation.behavior: AC1024+ TABLE parsing accepts the documented preamble defaults. A nonzero unknown RC/BL, non-null unknown soft pointer, false R2010 Boolean, or nonzero R2013+ BL commits the structurally readable entity prefix with semantic completeness false. The unknown soft pointer is not used as a TABLESTYLE identity; the TABLECONTENT style reference remains authoritative for the modeled field.

cases.result: semantic projection incomplete; pointer not mapped to TABLESTYLE

limitations: No meaning is assigned to non-default unknown fields.
The generated controls verify parser disposition, not producer interoperability or native rendering.
Exact raw-frame preservation and strict end-to-end output are separate gates and were not established by this vector.
next: Continue with the next locally ready source-backed P4/P6 slice; keep physical TABLE, native rendering, and non-default-prefix semantics unqualified.
